does_not_do: It works on return series, not holdings, so it does not measure concentration by position or issuer.
focus_reason: Volatility and drawdown are covered directly with few open issues (8) and steady releases (7 in the year); concentration has to be computed elsewhere.
measured_against: Need: measure concentration, volatility and drawdown of a portfolio from its holdings or returns, in code the user runs.
tests_ci: A tests/ directory; a compatibility-test workflow and a publish workflow.
what_it_is: A Python library for portfolio analytics from a returns series: metrics such as Sharpe ratio and volatility, drawdown and rolling-statistics plots, and HTML tear sheets.
